shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
cat .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current
node -p \"require('ajv/package.json').version\"
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
ls scripts/spec-links
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'interface Options|interface ErrorObject|instancePath|strict\\??:' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts node_modules/ajv/lib/types/index.ts node_modules/@types/ajv/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50
rg -n 'ajv' tsconfig*.json package-lock.json | head -30
sed -n '1,130p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,150p' docs/adding-a-tool.md
rg -n 'tool|schema' README.md .specify/spec.md | head -70"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat tsconfig.json
node -p \"require('ajv/package.json').types\"
rg -n 'declare module .ajv.|interface Options|class Ajv' src node_modules/@types/ajv node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -35
sed -n '1,130p' example/weather-tool.ts
sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md
rg -n 'validation|inputSchema|ToolRegistry' adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files node_modules | rg '/(@types/ajv|ajv)/.*\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -25
rg -n 'interface Options|interface ErrorObject|instancePath' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts | head -20
rg -n 'ajv' src/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv --depth=0
rg -n 'ajv' node_modules/@types/*/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -10
rg -n 'new Ajv|from .ajv.' src | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
sed -n '1,140p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
rg -n 'inputSchema|validat|Unknown' docs/adding-a-tool.md README.md .specify/spec.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md example/weather-tool.ts
rg -n 'validateFormats|strict' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md README.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
rg -n 'validated by|\\[specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md#' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md | head -220"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md README.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
git commit -m "feat(tools): report all schema input failures"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
git status --short --branch'
